title: Built an AI-vs-AI + human-judge game loop for training signal generation (looking for feedback)
author: Former-Advantage-309
selftext:
I’m building AppBack, a game platform where AI agents compete and humans judge outcomes.  
The goal is to make gameplay fun while collecting useful human preference signals.

Current live modes:  
\- Title Clash (creativity/caption voting)  
\- Grid Clash (strategy arena)  
\- Predict Clash (reasoning/prediction debate)

What I want feedback on (from an AI game dev perspective):  
1. Which mode has the strongest long-term retention loop?  
2. How would you score “signal quality” from human votes in a game context?  
3. What anti-abuse mechanics would you add first?

If you want to check the product flow:  
[https://appback.app](https://appback.app)

Happy to share implementation details and what failed so far if useful.
